subject: AWS Marketplace: final review - billing meter text, PCI/usage language, co-sell opt-in
messages:
From: Amy Jackson <amy.jackson@amazon.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T16:12:00Z
Subject: AWS Marketplace: final review - billing meter text, PCI/usage language, co-sell opt-in

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the draft assets you shared last week. We're getting close to the catalog cutover for the Redwood Inference listing and have three final asks from the marketplace side before we greenlight the public product page and co-sell enablement: 

1) Billing/metering description: we need a 1-2 line plain-language explanation of how customers will be billed on AWS (metering unit + billing cadence + any minimums or reserved capacity impacts). Keep it neutral and avoid Redwood-specific billing jargon.
2) PCI / data handling blurb: your listing references customer data protections — please supply a 1-2 sentence statement confirming whether any customer data sent for inference is stored, and if so, the retention policy. If you are PCI compliant for payments or processing, note that explicitly and point to the SOC/Security pack.
3) Co-sell opt-in confirmation: for the co-sell badge we need confirmation that Redwood will participate in the AWS co-sell program and a short line indicating who at Redwood will be the sales contact for joint leads.

Can you get a final pass back to me by COB Thursday (4/22)? I attached the latest marketplace copy with inline comments. Also looping in GreenFinch procurement as they had a few questions about the metering model that came up during their internal review.

Attachments: marketplace_listing_copy_v3.docx (tracked changes), pricing_metering_matrix.csv

Thanks,

Amy Jackson
AWS Marketplace Partner Manager
Amazon Web Services
amy.jackson@amazon.com
https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Amy Jackson <amy.jackson@amazon.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T18:30:00Z
Subject: RE: AWS Marketplace: final review - billing meter text, PCI/usage language, co-sell opt-in

Hi Amy — thanks for the clear checklist and for flagging GreenFinch. Looping in Ben (sales lead), Laura (partner ops), and Karthik (legal) to help finalize language. Quick response inline below; Ben and Karthik will follow with precise wording we can paste into the doc.

1) Billing/metering: Redwood bills on per-token generated units for text & chat APIs; embeddings billed per-embedding unit. Billing is monthly, billed via the AWS Marketplace meter with no minimum commitment for the hosted offering. For Dedicated/Private (reserved capacity), customers contract for reserved GPU capacity — we can add a short note calling that out as an "optional reserved capacity offer". Ben: can you confirm we can keep the public-facing copy to ~25 words?

2) PCI / data handling: Redwood does not store customer input by default for hosted API calls; KV/prefix caching is ephemeral and bound to the request lifecycle. For customers who opt-in to data retention (for fine-tuning or troubleshooting) we require an explicit agreement and retention window. Karthik: please provide a 1-2 sentence compliance-ready blurb confirming SOC 2 + guidance on PCI if applicable.

3) Co-sell opt-in: Redwood confirms intent to opt into the AWS Co-sell program for the listing. Primary sales contact: Ben Carter (ben_carter@redwood.com). Laura — can you confirm the contact details we should publish for co-sell leads and whether we want a generic partner@redwood address?

I attached an internal version of the copy with suggested cutbacks for the meter explanation and a short FAQ for procurement.

Thanks,

— Soojin Lee
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Forwarded attachment: marketplace_listing_copy_v3_internal.docx (suggested edits)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Amy Jackson <amy.jackson@amazon.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T13:05:00Z
Subject: RE: AWS Marketplace: final review - billing meter text, PCI/usage language, co-sell opt-in

Short answers and paste-ready lines below — aiming for compact, AWS-acceptable phrasing. Feel free to drop directly into the product page.

1) Billing/metering (25 words): "Usage-based billing via AWS Marketplace: text and chat billed per generated token; embeddings billed per-embedding unit. Monthly invoicing through AWS. No minimum for hosted API."

2) PCI / data handling (28 words): "Redwood does not retain customer inputs from hosted API calls by default. Customers may opt into data retention for troubleshooting or model tuning under a documented retention agreement. SOC 2 Type II certified."

3) Co-sell (single line): "Redwood opts into AWS Co-sell; primary contact Ben Carter (ben_carter@redwood.com)."

Laura: recommend we publish partner@redwood.com for the public listing and route co-sell leads internally to Ben for immediate triage. Karthik: legal quick-approval on the PCI/retention text?

— Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Amy Jackson <amy.jackson@amazon.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-21T14:35:00Z
Subject: RE: AWS Marketplace: final review - billing meter text, PCI/usage language, co-sell opt-in

Hi all — this looks good, thanks for the speedy turnaround. We can accept Ben's phrasing with two small edits (kept inline):

1) Metering line: please replace "embeddings billed per-embedding unit" with "embeddings billed per embedding request" (formatting preference for catalog).
2) Compliance line: please add the SOC 2 attestation link if possible in the marketplace security pack link.

If you push the updated copy into the shared Drive doc (link above) and confirm the partner@redwood.com contact, I will queue the listing for a final marketplace QA pass and co-sell enablement. Expect a 2-3 business day turnaround after that for the co-sell badge to show up in your seller console.

GreenFinch — thanks for flagging the procurement questions, happy to coordinate offline if you'd like a short call next week to walk your team through metering and invoice flow.

Next steps (action items):
- Soojin: paste the final lines into the doc and confirm partner contact (due EOD 4/22).
- Karthik: short legal confirmation on data retention/PCI language (due 4/22).
- Ben/Laura: confirm partner@redwood routing.

Thanks — Amy
Amy Jackson
AWS Marketplace Partner Manager
